text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai. Hanshin 
Racecourse is abuzz with voices focused
on 
Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spectators anticipating great 
performances,
and URA officials seeking to 
assess true potential—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To show them results and prove her 
strength, Sirius Symboli headed for the 
battlefield.
